tagline: A vocal compressor with RMS or peak detection and a parallel blend
description: A stereo-linked compressor aimed at vocals, with a choice of RMS (512-sample window) or peak level detection, manual makeup gain and a parallel mix control. Use it to even out a vocal's level, or blend in the dry signal for parallel compression that keeps the transients.

features.name: RMS or peak detection
features.description: RMS mode averages the level over a 512-sample window for smoother gain changes; Peak mode follows the instantaneous level.

features.name: Core controls
features.description: Threshold -60 to 0 dB (default -18), Ratio 1:1 to 20:1, Attack 0.1 to 100 ms and Release 10 to 1000 ms.

features.name: Makeup gain
features.description: Manual makeup from -12 to +24 dB applied to the compressed signal.

features.name: Parallel mix
features.description: Parallel Mix from 0 to 100% blends the uncompressed input back in; 0% is fully compressed.

features.name: Level readouts
features.description: The editor shows gain reduction and output level for each block.
